entities.name: P0CV01
observations: Reviewed Plasmopara viticola secreted RxLR effector protein 24; the supplied 510-aa sequence is an exact full-length sequence match.
UniProt annotation: secreted effector that acts as an elicitor inducing cell death in host plant cells.
Annotated signal peptide spans residues 1–18; mature chain spans residues 19–510.
Annotated localization includes extracellular region and host cell nucleus; reported nuclear speckle-like localization.

entities.name: Supplied protein sequence
observations: Length 510 aa; calculated molecular mass 56,722 Da; theoretical pI 6.67; predicted charge at pH 7 approximately -1.87.
N-terminal residues 1–18 are consistent with the curated secretory signal peptide annotation.
No explicit catalytic reaction or cofactor annotation was retrieved; Pfam scan returned no result in the available analysis module.

entities.name: RxLR-dEER motif
observations: The supplied protein contains the curated reference motif at residues 47–68, supporting classification as an oomycete RxLR effector.
